name: Your Time Has Come
detailed_description:
Your Time Has Come is a strategy game based on cards, where the player takes on the role of a conscious curse created by the Devil himself. Unlike other curses, you have developed full awareness, making you a threat to the infernal order. To prevent your rebellion, the Devil decides to imprison you and force you to fulfill assassination contracts, attempting to erase your consciousness and turn you into the perfect tool.

Each contract is a mission where you must use curse cards to manipulate the environment, set traps, and eliminate your targets without being detected. Cursed energy is an essential resource and must be carefully managed to ensure each card is used in the best possible way.

Between contracts, you return to the Hub, a space where you can interact with characters, buy new cards from the merchant, and reflect on your fate. Your choices throughout the game affect the course of the story, leading to one of three possible endings: submission to the Devil, escape from Hell, or complete destruction.

With a dark atmosphere, a stylized low-poly visual style, and an engaging narrative, Your Time Has Come challenges the player to think strategically and decide their own path.
